k:散.mnemonic: Strike (攵) a neat pile of twenty (廾) leaves with a stick, and for a month (月) afterwards you will be finding them in every corner of the garden. Scatter (disperse, spend, squander).
k:散.hint: One whack at the leaf pile.

k:精.mnemonic: Rice (米) polished until it almost glows blue (青) at the edges: every scrap of husk is gone and only the pure heart of the grain is left. Refined (energy, vitality, fairy).

k:採.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) curled like a claw (爪) reach up into the tree (木) and close around the ripest fruit on the branch. Pick (take, fetch, get).

k:暴.mnemonic: After a day (日) of building pressure, the water (水) in the well (井) bursts up all together (共) in one sudden roaring spout. Outburst (rave, force, violence).

k:幹.mnemonic: Early (早) each morning the woodcutter hangs his hat (𠆢) up to dry (干) on a stub that sticks out of the thick upright body of the oak. Tree trunk (main part, talent, ability).
k:幹.hint: Hat hung on the oak's stub.

k:甲.mnemonic: A breastplate ruled into squares like a rice field (田), hammered to a bend (曲) so that it curves around the chest, with one strap hanging below. Armor (A grade, first class).

k:廃.mnemonic: The departure (発) board under the station canopy (广) goes blank. The line has been scrapped and no train will ever leave from here again. Abolish (obsolete, discarding, abandon).

k:喜.mnemonic: After the long march a hungry samurai (士) is handed a steaming bowl of beans (豆), and his mouth opens wide in a shout of delight. Rejoice (take pleasure in).

k:抜.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) quietly change (変) the real key for a copy, and also (又) ease the door open while the guard dozes. The prisoner is through and away. Slip out (extract, pull out, pilfer).

k:費.mnemonic: Every bill is a pull (引) on your purse of shellfish (貝) coins: one tug at the string and another shell is gone. Expense (cost, spend, waste).

k:創.mnemonic: The first cut of the knife (刂) into a blank block, placed to suit (合) the sculptor's idea: the moment something new begins to exist. Genesis (wound, injury, start).

k:圧.mnemonic: An overhang (厂) of rock bears down on the soil (土) beneath it, squeezing it hard and flat. Pressure (push, overwhelm, oppress).

k:舞.mnemonic: There is nothing (無) on the stage but ten thousand (万) lanterns, and through them a pair of dancing legs (舛) whirls in and out of the light. Dance (flit, circle, wheel).

k:祭.mnemonic: The priest in his tall hat (𠆢) steps into the tent (癶) and puts the offerings on show (示) at the altar, in the same order every year. Ritual (offer prayers, celebrate, enshrine).

k:責.mnemonic: Six (六) shellfish (貝) coins were buried in the soil (土), and now they are gone. Every head turns toward the one holding the spade. Blame (responsibility, condemn, censure).

k:積.mnemonic: The grain (禾) keeps heaping up in the barn until the walls bulge, and the farmer takes the blame (責) for never working out how much it would hold. Volume (acreage, contents, pile up).

k:婚.mnemonic: The day (日) a woman (女) joins a new clan (氏): two families feast at one table and two names are tied together. Marriage.
k:婚.hint: The day she joins a new clan.

k:卒.mnemonic: After ten (十) years of study each person (人) throws a cap in the air, and they walk out of the school gate side by side. Graduate (soldier, private).
k:卒.hint: Caps in the air after ten years.

k:札.mnemonic: A fishhook (乙) stuck into a tree (木) holds a small slip of paper that gives the tree's name and number. Tag (paper money, placard, bid).
k:札.hint: Paper slip hooked to a tree.

k:効.mnemonic: The right herbs mingle (交) in the pot and the brew gains power (力): one cup and the fever is gone. It truly works. Merit (efficacy, efficiency, benefit).

k:推.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) press on a wrapped parcel, feeling its shape. From the weight and the wing bones you reason that it must be a turkey (隹). Conjecture (infer, guess, suppose).

k:値.mnemonic: The leader (亻) of the market looks you straight (直) in the eye and names a number. There will be no haggling. Price (cost, value).
k:値.hint: A number, straight to your face.

k:課.mnemonic: The teacher sits under a tree (木) beside the rice field (田) and says (言) one part of the lesson each day, then stops until tomorrow. Chapter (lesson, section, department).
k:課.hint: One part of the lesson a day.

k:娘.mnemonic: A young woman (女) every bit as stubborn (艮) as her mother, which is how the neighbours can tell whose girl she is. Daughter (girl).

k:承.mnemonic: Asked two (二) times, he lets his objection slide (ノ), hangs his coat on the hook (亅) and raises a hand (手): all right, he will go along with it. Acquiesce (hear, be informed, receive).

k:乱.mnemonic: One sharp tongue (舌) catches the crowd like a fishhook (乙) and drags it out into the street, shouting and overturning carts. Riot (disorder, disturb, war).
k:乱.hint: A sharp tongue hooks the crowd.

k:超.mnemonic: You run (走) so far past the finish that the guard lowers his sword (刀) and stands with his mouth (口) open: nobody has ever gone beyond this line. Transcend (super-, ultra-).

k:雄.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) bursts out of its cocoon (厶) of baby down, fans its tail and puffs out its chest to show everyone which bird is the cock. Masculine (male, hero, leader).

k:囲.mnemonic: A fence (囗) built around all four sides of the well (井), so that nothing can wander up and fall in. Surround (besiege, enclosure).
